training_method.label: Research recording only
training_method.description: This contract smoke test records system evidence and does not claim to train a model.

execution_topology.label: Local deterministic bundle generation
execution_topology.description: One process validates linked inputs and atomically writes a content-verifiable result directory.

memory_profiles.label: Ordinary local filesystem
memory_profiles.description: The fixture uses only small JSON and Markdown files on the host filesystem.

numerical_profiles.label: Canonical JSON and SHA-256
numerical_profiles.description: Inputs and results use sorted compact UTF-8 JSON with SHA-256 content identities.

worker_profiles.label: Python 3.11 local operator
worker_profiles.description: Any operator able to install the locked OrcaColony development environment and run the CLI.

reproduction.notes: Run from the repository root at the exact implementation revision after creating a fresh output path.
